text:
marta: Quick sync — we need a crisp decision on retention buckets + BYOK rollback behavior before the enterprise pilot next sprint. Customers want per-tenant retention windows and a clear behavior when customer KEKs are revoked/destroyed. Short thread, please chime in with concrete asks or blockers. :eyes:

jonathan: Agree. We also need the SOC2 mapping for whatever retention buckets we pick, plus ISO e-discovery expectations. Customers will ask for an evidence export SLA (format, time-to-export).

alex_k: From infra side: per-tenant TTLs are doable but search/indexing and export interact badly with immediate deletes. My recommendation: 3 retention tiers (short/standard/long) + a legal-hold mode that prevents purge. Proposal below.

samira: Ops note — key lifecycle is the tricky bit. If a customer revokes/destroys their KEK, we lose ability to decrypt blobs. We need an explicit workflow: snapshot/export attempts before irrevocable destroy, or require customer attestation. Also need cost + storage impact callout.

marta: Proposed config shape and launch criteria (rough):
```
retention_config: {
  tiers: [
    {name: "short", ttl_days: 30, export_window_hours: 72},
    {name: "standard", ttl_days: 365, export_window_hours: 168},
    {name: "long", ttl_days: 2555, export_window_hours: 336} // ~7y
  ],
  legal_hold: {enabled: true, override_ttl: true},
  byok_key_policy: {revoke_grace_hours: 48, pre_destroy_export: true, attestation_required: true}
}
launch_criteria: ["SOC2 control mapping complete","Ops runbook + rollback steps","2 pilot customers signed up","Export format spec + test harness"]
```
Thoughts on those numbers? Also need acceptance criteria mapped to SOC2/ISO controls and a simple UI flow for tenant retention selection. :thinking_face:

jonathan: Additions: require keystore attestation before permanent destroy, and send webhook notifications to customer 72/48/24 hours before enforced destroy. For legal hold, require signed legal request to disable. Also we should list which SOC2 controls this touches (CC6, CC7-ish) in the PR.

alex_k: For indexing/search: prefer soft-delete + purge job. Implementation: mark records as deleted, remove from live indexes immediately, keep encrypted blobs until purge job runs post-export window. That lets searches respect retention while preserving ability to export if within export_window. Caveat: increases storage and SLO complexity.

samira: Oncall/playbook asks:
- Pilot with 2 customers on Dedicated or Private only (so we can control keys)
- Metrics: export_success_rate >= 99%, time_to_export <= 6h for <= 100GB, purge_job_error_rate < 0.1%
- Runbook entries: how to handle orphaned blobs (key missing), manual export workflow, escalation to legal
If we add the revoke_grace_hours flow, ops needs a background job to detect impending destroys and trigger exports.

marta: Great — action items I will own this week: create PR with config + SOC2/ISO control mapping, draft product UI copy for tenant retention selection, coordinate ops for runbook, and set up pilot signoff criteria. Owners: @jonathan (security controls + attestation language), @alex_k (indexing + purge design), @samira (ops runbook + metrics). I'll post the PR and a simple demo doc by EOW. :shipit:
